unit_audit.canonical_closure: A three-credit mathematics branch choice plus the published 15-credit elective minimum closes the degree at 60.

residency.rule: At least 30 of the minimum 60 degree credits must be completed at Richard Bland College.

modeling_notes: Richard Bland publishes one combined Math/Computer Science A.S. under CIP 30.0801. This artifact exposes its Computer Science branch and does not relabel the award as a standalone Computer Science A.S.
The Computer Science branch is CSCI 222 and exactly one of MATH 254, MATH 261, or MATH 271, in addition to the common CSCI 221, MATH 251, and MATH 252 courses.

The printed 15-16 elective block is retained as an unenumerated credit category. Its named mathematics and natural-science courses are recommendations for transfer planning, not additional AND requirements.

The program page says the quantitative and symbolic reasoning component satisfies computer proficiency, so no additional computer-proficiency course is added. Foreign language is transfer-planning guidance, not a requirement of this degree.

The minimum published component values close at 60. The printed maxima can total 62, and the four-credit MATH 261 branch combined with the 15-credit elective minimum totals 61; this source conflict is retained and blocks analysis readiness.

All course codes are Richard Bland institution-local identities. They are supported directly by the reviewed Richard Bland program page and must not be treated as VCCS master-course records merely because a normalized code overlaps.
